issues.on_page: Interest/Dividends 51,083 (printed under Other Financing Sources, below Total revenues)
issues.issue: Interest is a revenue printed below the statement's total; the extractor rules (outside_printed_total) say such lines (explicitly 'interest income under Other Financing Sources') are recorded as receipt items with outside_printed_total: true, not as other_financing. FY2024 made the same choice (other_financing 89,847), so both years would need the same fix. The p8 A-1 schedule counts it inside Total Revenues (6,644,739).
issues.resolved: kept in other_financing: printed under Other Financing Sources; user rule 2026-10-29/11-06 amounts follow the printed section (matches FY2024)

issues.issue: SoA p2 counts it as general revenue 'Miscellaneous revenue (Expense)', not Charges for Services; under the 2026-11-06 utility other-revenue ruling it would be other. Carries a user category_decision (Sale of Merchandise), so left as a warning.

issues.on_page: A-1 'General Fund' schedule whose actuals equal Total Governmental Funds
issues.issue: Confirmed: A-1 actuals tie to all governmental funds (revenue 6,644,739 = 6,593,656 + interest 51,083; expenditures 7,145,644 = total), so it already contains the B-2 nonmajor funds (Local 16,501 = 'Other governmental' charges for services; expenditures 31,860 = general government 8,553 + cemetery 23,307; interest 2,092). Leaving B-2 (p9) out avoids double counting and no amount is lost; only the per-fund split of the nonmajor funds (Steele Trust Cemetery, Library Project, Unemployment) is not shown, and the A-1 lines are tagged fund 'General Fund' although they cover every governmental fund.
